evaluation: recorded RGB with achieved simulation-state feedback
scene: fixed-base G1/Dex1, no calibrated task objects or liquid dynamics
limitations: Recorded RGB does not respond to simulated actions; this is not a fully closed-loop visual test.
No grasp or task success is measured.
One validation episode per skill, same take-tube episode for both models.
Dex1 motor-to-slider mapping and PD gains are diagnostic approximations.
Videos play at recorded 30 FPS, not measured inference speed.
selection: Median-length validation episode per skill; only one water-bath validation episode
